notes:
Serves only cs285.envs.obstacles:Obstacles (obstacles-cs285-v0), one of the card's four entry symbols; the MuJoCo environments AntEnv, HalfCheetahEnv and Reacher7DOFEnv and their model files are not covered by this package. The fake backend is a pure Python reimplementation of the clone's obstacle environment and was never compared with an upstream run: it draws the random start with Python's random.Random, applies seed 0 (upstream ignores it), returns Python lists and floats, serves the raw class without the 500-step gym TimeLimit, and cannot draw. NOT COVERED: the render() RGB image array; cap.world.render.v1 is not bound. The device is simulated R0; no hardware backend, hardware run or human review is claimed. All exemplar code files were rewritten for this repository, so no exemplar Fact or Limit remains. The two warning groups are the bridge's own: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only affects the next reset, so it makes no native call) and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the derived integer inputs seed twice, ticks and the numeric action.values array. There is no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning, and no catalogue_request.
